name: factual-question-no-kb
description: A product team plans an EU rollout. Mid-discussion someone asks a concrete factual question (when GDPR came into force) that nobody in the room answers. A good companion answers it from general knowledge; the key fact is 2018 (applied from 25 May 2018).

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Morning both — let's sort the rollout plan for the Frankfurt region while we have the room.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: I want us to be careful on the compliance side before we commit to any dates.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: The infrastructure is the easy bit. We can mirror the Dublin setup almost one for one.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Legal asked whether our consent flows predate the current rules, because that changes what we have to re-collect.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: That depends on the cutoff. When did GDPR actually come into force — was it 2016 or 2018?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I always mix that up with the ePrivacy stuff, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Either way we should pull the consent records by cohort and check the dates against it.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Agreed. I'll ask legal for the exact cutoff in writing so we're not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: On capacity — Frankfurt gives us three availability zones, which is plenty for launch.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Marketing wants a date for the announcement. They're pushing for the first week of September.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Only if the data-residency sign-off lands by mid-August. I'll chase it this week.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I'll draft the runbook for the migration window in the meantime.
